sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent operations, coordination, learned memory, local generative media, and office automation dominate. TypeScript appears in 3 listed repositories, Python in 2, and JavaScript, PLSQL, and TeX once each.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The list is moving beyond model wrappers toward memory, orchestration, office execution, and local media production.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub attention is shifting toward durable agent products that work across real contexts, with local voice tooling showing a parallel practicalization trend in generative media.
